def has_matching_key(env): return env.carrying is not None and env.carrying.type == "key" and any(cell is not None and cell.type == "door" and cell.color == env.carrying.color for y in range((env.room_size - 1) * (max([ball_y for ball_x in range(env.width) for ball_y in range(env.height) for ball_cell in [env.grid.get(ball_x, ball_y)] if ball_cell is not None and ball_cell.type == "ball"], default=env.agent_pos[1]) // (env.room_size - 1)), (env.room_size - 1) * (max([ball_y for ball_x in range(env.width) for ball_y in range(env.height) for ball_cell in [env.grid.get(ball_x, ball_y)] if ball_cell is not None and ball_cell.type == "ball"], default=env.agent_pos[1]) // (env.room_size - 1)) + env.room_size) for cell in [env.grid.get(env.width - env.room_size, y)])

def target_door_open(env): return any(cell is not None and cell.type == "door" and cell.is_open for y in range((env.room_size - 1) * (max([ball_y for ball_x in range(env.width) for ball_y in range(env.height) for ball_cell in [env.grid.get(ball_x, ball_y)] if ball_cell is not None and ball_cell.type == "ball"], default=env.agent_pos[1]) // (env.room_size - 1)), (env.room_size - 1) * (max([ball_y for ball_x in range(env.width) for ball_y in range(env.height) for ball_cell in [env.grid.get(ball_x, ball_y)] if ball_cell is not None and ball_cell.type == "ball"], default=env.agent_pos[1]) // (env.room_size - 1)) + env.room_size) for cell in [env.grid.get(env.width - env.room_size, y)])

def target_room_entered(env): return (env.episode_memory["previous_valuation"] and env.episode_memory["previous_valuation"]["target_room_entered"]) or (env.agent_pos[0] >= env.width - env.room_size and 0 <= env.agent_pos[1] - (env.room_size - 1) * (max([ball_y for ball_x in range(env.width) for ball_y in range(env.height) for ball_cell in [env.grid.get(ball_x, ball_y)] if ball_cell is not None and ball_cell.type == "ball"], default=env.agent_pos[1]) // (env.room_size - 1)) <= env.room_size - 1)

def target_picked_up(env): return env.carrying is not None and env.carrying.type == "ball" and env.mission == f"pick up the {env.carrying.color} ball"
